exec: pm.test("status ok", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "ok").to.be.true; });

pm.test("una fuente usda CC0 con todos los campos", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.length === 1 && j[0].id === "usda" && j[0].license === "CC0" && ["id","name","version","license","citation","url"].every(k => typeof j[0][k] === "string" && j[0][k].length > 0)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("20 elementos y total 2376", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.length === 20 && j.total === 2376 && j.limit === 20 && j.offset === 0).to.be.true; });

pm.test("orden por nombre científico", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.map(i => i.scientificName).join("|") === j.items.map(i => i.scientificName).sort().join("|")).to.be.true; });

pm.test("forma de cada elemento", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.every(i => "id" in i && "scientificName" in i && Array.isArray(i.commonNames) && "family" in i)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("5 elementos, offset 10", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.length === 5 && j.offset === 10 && j.total === 2376).to.be.true; });
